triggers.symptom: Model is 89% accurate at predicting pregnancy, wants to mail baby coupons
triggers.action: Predictive accuracy does NOT equal ethical permissibility. Propose opt-in mixed bundles + flag stored-data breach risk.

triggers.symptom: Returning planes / active 6-month users surveyed -> 'everything works great'
triggers.action: Ask who is missing from the sample (non-returning planes, week-1 churned users).

triggers.symptom: Press release blames 'pilot checklists' and calls fixes 'enhancements'
triggers.framework: Close Reading: Framing, Euphemism & Omission (Boeing 737 MAX)
triggers.action: Expose blame-shifting and omitted single-sensor flaws; audit claims against internal memos.

triggers.symptom: Engineers warned early, leadership suppressed delays to beat rival
triggers.action: Propose independent Safety Sign-Off reporting to Board Risk Committee + protected Red-Team stop-ship authority.

triggers.symptom: '1% of 1.4 billion Indians will buy our ₹2,000 desk every month'
triggers.action: Filter 1.4B down to actual office buyers and note durable goods are bought once in years, not monthly.

triggers.symptom: 'Our campaign ran Tuesday, sales rose Thursday, so campaign worked'
triggers.action: Temporal sequence does not prove causation; check seasonality, discounts, and confounders.

triggers.symptom: 'Either slash R&D 40% today or we go bankrupt'
triggers.action: Reject forced binary; surface middle options (phased capex, pricing tiers, working-capital release).

triggers.symptom: 'We already spent ₹300 Cr on slots, so keep flying the losing route'
triggers.action: Decide strictly on marginal future cash flows; historical spend is unrecoverable.

triggers.symptom: Junior spots fatal flaw in VP's plan during meeting, stays silent
triggers.action: Use private pre-meeting hypothesis testing ('under what conditions could this fail?') to surface dissent safely.

triggers.symptom: 'Survey says customers want classic white, so ignore new pastel prototypes'
triggers.action: Customers only prefer what they have seen; validate novel designs via physical prototypes, not surveys.

modules.title: M1 & M2: Evidence & Close Reading
modules.summary: Separate logic from complete evidence, facts from inferences, and surface rhetoric from hidden omissions.

nodes.label: Logic vs. Critical Thinking & Challenger
nodes.short: Logic checks conclusion from premises; CT checks if premises are complete and ethical.
bullets: Challenger: Engineers had valid O-ring concern, but omitted zero-damage temperature baseline.
Target Case: Technical accuracy (89%) fails when ethical consent/privacy is ignored.
nodes.trap: Soundness requires BOTH valid structure AND factually true, unbiased premises.

nodes.label: Evidence Triad & Wald's Invisible Record
bullets: Test assertions vs. verifiable evidence; ask what missing data is invisible (survivorship bias).
Framing (₹100 surcharge vs. ₹100 discount) flips choices via Loss Aversion.

nodes.label: Close Reading, Omission & 5 Cs
nodes.short: Spot euphemisms, confident intensifiers, and retrospective narrative illusions.
bullets: Explicit Claim vs. Implicit Position: audit word choice, repetition, and strategic omissions.
Reasonable Person Test: anchor meaning in plain text, not private author intent.
5 Cs (Hare-Tortoise): clean retrospective stories mask luck and survivor bias.

modules.title: M3 & M4: Arguments, Biases & Fallacies
modules.summary: Deconstruct pitches via C-E-R / Toulmin and spot the top cognitive biases and logical fallacies.

nodes.label: C-E-R & Toulmin's 6-Part Model
nodes.short: Claim + Grounds + Warrant (bridge) + Backing + Qualifier + Rebuttal.
bullets: Netflix 2006: Always expose unstated assumptions (studio licensing, bandwidth).
Deductive = necessary certainty (valid vs. sound); Inductive = probable generalization.
Ethos (credibility) + Pathos (emotion) collapse in due diligence without Logos (unit economics).
nodes.trap: Warrant is the logical bridge principle; Backing is the evidence supporting that warrant.

nodes.label: System 1, WYSIATI & Cognitive Traps
nodes.short: Base Rate Neglect, Sunk Cost, Availability, Anchoring, Planning Fallacy.
bullets: WYSIATI: System 1 builds confident stories from visible facts alone, ignoring base rates.
Confirmation Bias (passive) vs. Motivated Reasoning (active defense of desired outcome).
Hindsight Bias ('knew it all along') blocks honest post-mortems.

nodes.label: Top Exam Logical Fallacies
nodes.short: Post Hoc, False Dilemma, Strawman/Steelman, Ad Hominem, Tu Quoque.
bullets: Post Hoc (sequence != cause); False Dilemma (forced binary); Slippery Slope (unproven chain).
Strawman (distort to attack) vs. Steelman (reconstruct strongest case first).
Circular Reasoning, Equivocation (word-shift), Bandwagon, False Authority.

modules.title: M5 & M6: Authority, Values & Nyaya
modules.summary: Audit experts, separate Facts from Values, and apply Nyaya logic + cross-cultural humility.

nodes.label: Expertise Audit & Fact-Value Gap
nodes.short: Check domain scope + conflicts of interest; data ('is') never dictates ethics ('ought').
bullets: False Authority = citing prestige outside competence or hiding paid advisory ties.
Epistemic Humility: state falsification conditions and update on disconfirming data.

nodes.label: Nyaya 5-Step Inference & Single Story
nodes.short: Nyaya grounds deduction in Udaharana (concrete empirical example).
bullets: 5 steps add Udaharana (real-world example) + application, uniting logic with observation.
Blurry JPEG: executive summaries compress away edge cases.
Single Story: flattening regions/segments causes mispricing and missed niches.

modules.title: M7 & M8: Organisations & Practice
modules.summary: Institutional accountability, Pre-Mortems, Hustle Culture premise, and real-world prototyping.

nodes.label: Accountability, Groupthink & Pre-Mortem
nodes.short: Test espoused claims against promotion/memo records; institutionalize dissent.
bullets: Structural Devil's Advocacy + independent Safety Sign-Off beats 'just speak up.'
Pre-Mortem: imagine failure 1 year out to surface risks safely before launch.
Hustle Culture Premise Problem: hours != output; fatigue degrades System 2.

nodes.label: Exposure Gap, Prototyping & Artisans
nodes.short: Test highest-risk assumptions cheaply via prototypes and stakeholder listening.
bullets: Whites & Pastels: physical prototypes bridge the survey Exposure Gap.
Kolhapuri Artisans: protect craft authenticity via milestone working-capital advances.
Sangeeta Menon: frontline suppliers spot red flags before lagging financials.

traps.trap: Exceeding word limits (20-30w in Sec B, 40-50w in Sec C) with fluff
traps.fix: Hit exact deliverables cleanly: Framework name -> Diagnosis -> 1 Fix -> 1 Residual Risk.
An argument can be structurally Valid while having false premises (Unsound).

traps.trap: Confusing Warrant with Backing in Toulmin
traps.fix: Warrant = logical rule connecting Grounds to Claim; Backing = evidence proving the Warrant.

traps.trap: Calling every critique of a speaker 'Ad Hominem'
traps.fix: Exposing an undisclosed financial conflict of interest is a legitimate credibility check, not Ad Hominem.

traps.trap: Ignoring the low prior base rate when test accuracy is 90%
traps.fix: Always check Base Rate Neglect before trusting posterior probabilities.

traps.trap: Equating Confirmation Bias with Motivated Reasoning
traps.fix: Confirmation bias is passive selective attention; Motivated Reasoning actively defends a desired conclusion.

traps.trap: Assuming Nyaya is just a longer Western syllogism
traps.fix: Its defining strength is Udaharana—anchoring universal rules in observed empirical examples.

traps.trap: Recommending 'encourage people to speak up' to fix Groupthink
traps.fix: Always propose structural protection (rotating Devil's Advocate, independent risk reporting, Pre-Mortem).
